Method of Attack: Distributed through exploit kits (Nuclear Exploit Kit) exploiting vulnerabilities in Flash, Silverlight, PDF, Java, and Internet Explorer
Use of NSIS installer with encrypted data files and DLL to install malware payload
Impacted Systems: Systems vulnerable to Flash, Silverlight, PDF, Java, Internet Explorer exploits
Attack Vector: Exploit kits installed on hacked websites redirecting victims through gateways to exploit kit landing pages
Indicators of Compromise: Domains registered via Bizcn.com registrar (BizCN gate actor)
